intent_snapshot.goal: Implement docs/specs/issue-426-review-git-and-pi-tui.spec.md: claude-code reviewers and verifiers can run the read-only git forms models emit (#426 F10); a Pi Executor outside Herdr is handed to the user with lane_executor_requires_tui instead of a print-mode run that cannot settle (#426 F9); the #426 report and validation plan record F8 as a test configuration error.

acceptance.assertion: Per D1 of docs/specs/issue-426-review-git-and-pi-tui.spec.md: for the claude-code profile, reviewArguments and verificationArguments each pass exactly twelve --allowedTools rules, the six Bash(git <sub>:*) rules for show, diff, log, cat-file, rev-parse and ls-tree plus the same six as Bash(git --no-pager <sub>:*), and both lists are equal. Negative cases pinned in tests: no rule starts with Bash(git -C, no rule names a non-git command, no rule is a bare Bash, --tools stays Read,Grep,Glob,Bash and --permission-mode stays dontAsk. The pi and antigravity reviewer and verifier argv are unchanged.

Per D2 of docs/specs/issue-426-review-git-and-pi-tui.spec.md: the authority-review skill, the code-review role prompt and the review-verifier role prompt each instruct the role to run one git command at a time from the current working directory, without -C, pipes or redirection, with --no-pager only as the first argument; a test fails when any of the three loses that instruction. The dist/role-prompts mirrors match their runtime/prompts sources, and any test that pins the review contract hash is updated to the new value.

Per D4 of docs/specs/issue-426-review-git-and-pi-tui.spec.md: superviseLane with an Executor choice of host pi on an active Lane that has no open user decision returns state unavailable, generation null, exit null and reason lane_executor_requires_tui, without calling LaneSupervisor.run, starting a process or writing the generation store (the test's supervisor double fails if run is called). Controls: the same call with host claude-code still starts a generation; with host pi on a Lane whose lifecycle is not active, or that awaits the user, it returns the existing exited observation with no reason.

Per D5 of docs/specs/issue-426-review-git-and-pi-tui.spec.md (BR-SCN-2): a single-task start_unattended_batch under runtime supervision (not interactive) whose resolved executor host is pi returns reason lane_executor_requires_tui, keeps the child enrolled rather than parked to needs_human, keeps the executor handoff with the Lane path and task_id, adds no lane_refusals entry, and its next_action tells the user to run /skill:drive <task_id> in interactive pi in that Lane and call start_unattended_batch again. Re-entry after the Lane's run is no longer active advances the batch without starting a process. The decision relay returns the same reason in lane_relay.lane_supervision. BATCH_REASONS includes lane_executor_requires_tui as blocked with that recovery action.

Per D3 and D6 of docs/specs/issue-426-review-git-and-pi-tui.spec.md: dist/drive-batch.md no longer says the runtime spawns pi --print outside Herdr and states that a Pi Executor outside Herdr is reported with lane_executor_requires_tui and handed to the user under the no-supervised-session rule, pinned by a contract test; the generated Claude bundle and the antigravity artifact match their sources.

Per D7 of docs/specs/issue-426-review-git-and-pi-tui.spec.md: docs/reports/issue-426-herdr-provider-probe.md marks F8 as a non-defect (test configuration error) citing ADR 0037 and layered_config.ts, and records F9 and F10 with their root cause and fix (lane_executor_requires_tui, the --no-pager allow-list), keeping the existing uncommitted edits; section 7 of docs/reports/issue-426-local-validation-plan.md selects the reviewer through an active user lane profile (lanes.profiles and lanes.active) or the request instead of telling the tester to put the review keys into .imm/config.json.

intent_snapshot.scope_size_reason: Two small fixes that close the #426 third-round defects together: they share the report rows, the release changeset and one live re-run, and only the reviewer allow-list changes a trust boundary. The count is high because each side carries its prompt mirrors, reason table and three focused test files.

attestations.summary: Provenance verified (single parent 97152e22, tree bbabc896). RGT-A1 to A6 are met. The 12-rule shared REVIEW_GIT_ALLOWED_TOOLS list adds only --no-pager forms, with no -C, non-git or bare Bash rule, and is pinned by tests. The plain-cwd git instruction is in the skill, both prompts and their mirrors. The Pi refusal in superviseLane comes after the not-active, awaiting-user and open-decision early return and before run or any store write. superviseSingle keeps the child enrolled with its executor handoff, adds no lane_refusals entry and fills task_id into next_action. The new reason is in BATCH_REASONS, and the contract text, reports, bundles and antigravity mirrors match their sources. Blast radius: medium; the load-bearing paths are cli_review.ts (the reviewer trust boundary), lane_supervisor.ts and batch_runner.ts (Lane supervision state machine), and the generated mcp-server.mjs bundles; no persisted shape changes.

advisory_findings.summary: For a Pi Executor outside Herdr, a replan-only Lane decision is not one of the superviseLane early returns. The report therefore carries lane_executor_requires_tui instead of lane_decision_required, so the decision is only seen once the user opens interactive pi. The behaviour matches D4's placement and the test pins it, but the operator is not told a decision is pending.

evidence.trigger: host pi, Lane active with only a replan_required decision (open_user_decision_count 0, next_obligation not awaiting_user) → superviseLane returns requires_tui before superviseSingle reads laneDecisionFacts → report omits lane_decision_required
